{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% to align with historical volatility.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment turns negative after a peak, especially if true outcome shows rapid decline.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; lagged sentiment (e.g., 2-3 days prior) should influence correction more than immediate sentiment.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, reduce future forecast highs by 5-15% to reflect underestimation bias.",
    "When sentiment is positive but forecast is overoptimistic, apply a 5-10% downward correction to prevent overbought scenarios."
  ]
}
